source: plexscratch (PMS 1.43.4.10903) 2026-10-14: TV Shows held Firefly (key 6; S1E1-3, S2E1-3) and an unmatched 'Qzxv Merge Probe (2002)' (key 58) with S01E01 (62, a copy of Big Buck Bunny) and S03E01 (60, a copy of another clip). PUT /library/metadata/6/merge?ids=58, then each row's children and GET /library/metadata/{key}. The probe's season keys were not read.
reading: A paired episode (same season and index) becomes another Media of the target's episode and its own key is gone; an unpaired one moves under the target on its own key, into a season of its index the target gains on a new key; the merged show is gone.
